description: This file defines a Flutter screen for user signup, supporting OTP and password-based registration flows. It includes UI components, form validation, and interaction with authentication APIs and session management.

classes.name: SignupScreen
classes.description: A Flutter widget representing the user signup screen with options for OTP verification or password registration.

classes.name: _SignupScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the signup form, input validation, API interactions, and navigation logic for SignupScreen.

methods.name: _requestOtp
methods.description: Sends an OTP request for the provided phone number, updates the state based on success or failure, and manages OTP request limits.

methods.name: _verifyOtpAndCreate
methods.description: Verifies the entered OTP, handles session token storage, and navigates to dashboard on success, with error handling for various API error cases.

methods.name: _signupWithPassword
methods.description: Performs password-based registration, saves session tokens, and handles errors such as duplicate accounts.
